description: This file defines the TokenStream class in the Twig templating engine, managing token iteration, lookahead, and error handling within a token stream.

classes.name: TokenStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream of tokens for parsing templates in Twig.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TokenStream with an array of tokens and an optional source.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the token stream as a string.

methods.name: injectTokens
methods.description: Injects additional tokens into the current token stream at the current position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next token and returns the previous one.

methods.name: nextIf
methods.description: Tests the current token and advances if the condition is met.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts the current token matches expected type and value, throws SyntaxError if not.

methods.name: look
methods.description: Peeks at upcoming tokens without advancing.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests the current token against given criteria.

methods.name: isEOF
methods.description: Checks if the end of the token stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context associated with the token stream.
